feeds.title: The Education Hub » Vocational Education
feeds.description: The Education Hub is a site for parents, pupils, education professionals and the media that captures all you need to know about the education system. You'll find accessible, straightforward information on popular topics, Q&As, interviews, case studies, and more.

feeds.title: Vocational Training HQ Blog
feeds.description: We are a leading property for vocational training and adult education. We specialize in advanced technologies that enable us to provide A+ and top-tier services, with the aid of our high-quality content. Our goal is to connect everyone around the world together in the field of vocational education. Our vision is to make vocational training more accessible, affordable, and possible for today's generation.

feeds.title: Canadian Vocational Training Centre Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Vocational Training Centre is a designated private training institution operating primarily in the province of British Columbia. Open since 2013, we know that college isn't for everyone, but education is! We also know that employers hire people, not certifications. Our Mission Statement at the Canadian Vocational Training Centre is: Educate, Empower, Employ. We strive to help our students achieve their personal, educational, and career goals in a timely and cost-effective manner.

feeds.title: Vocational Rehabilitation Workforce Studio » Podcast
feeds.description: The VR Workforce Studio is a podcast rooted in the State Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) Program in the Commonwealth of Virginia. The core mission and purpose of the VR Workforce Studio is to offer important compelling information and stories for Individuals with disabilities (IWD) who are 'in' or 'preparing to be part of' the workforce in Virginia as well as employers and the staff who help IWD become employed. The show is produced at WWRC, a comprehensive vocational rehabilitation center that serves over 300 IWD on any given day helping them prepare for employment...

feeds.title: Vocations and Learning Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Stephen Billett is a Professor of Adult and Vocational Education in the School of Education and Professional Studies at Griffith University, Brisbane, Australia, and a National Teaching Fellow and Australian Research Council Future Fellow.

feeds.title: Vocational Solutions of Henderson County Blog
feeds.description: At Vocational Solutions of Henderson County, we are dedicated to providing career and life skills training to adults with disabilities or other vocational barriers in a safe, caring environment. Our organization offers programs facilitated by qualified staff members who foster each person's potential for self-sufficiency and quality of life and engage in income-generating business enterprises to sustain the long-term goals of program participant employment.
